product_one_liner.value: SnapLogic's Agentic Integration and Applied AI Platform connects enterprise applications, data, APIs, and AI agents across cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments as an AI operational layer for enterprises.

pricing_page.notes: The page lists Essential, Professional, and Enterprise One packages.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists the company size as 201–500 employees.

eng_blog.notes: The technical posts cover SnapLogic test infrastructure and Kafka Consumer Snap behavior; their authors are identified as a QA Lead and a Principal Engineer.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation site includes API Management, Public APIs, and AgentCreator documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers board lists open roles, but none of the displayed job titles is an AI, ML, or data-science role.

model_provider.notes: The public SnapGPT workflow article says user input is sent to Claude on Amazon Bedrock.

compliance_certs.notes: From the requested set, the security page names SOC 2 Type 2, HIPAA, and GDPR.

last_funding.notes: PitchBook lists a completed Debt - General entry dated August 13, 2025, with no amount disclosed. This is the latest dated financing entry found; the amount is not publicly specified in that record.

raised_18mo.notes: PitchBook reports a completed Debt - General financing dated August 13, 2025, within the 18-month window. The amount is not disclosed in that entry, and I did not find a primary financing announcement.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A Senior Enterprise Account Executive posting is listed as a full-time sales role.

launched_6mo.notes: On October 20, 2026, SnapLogic announced new capabilities across its Agentic Integration Platform.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: On May 12, 2026, SnapLogic announced Molly Matthews as President and promoted Anjana Kashyap and Cassie Capano to Chief Customer Officer and Chief People Officer. The announcement does not state Matthews's employment start date; this is a documented leadership appointment and promotions, not a claim that all three newly joined the company.
